as.sfi_deduplication_instructions:
Review Senegal CE1 bilingual Wolof/French candidates conservatively. Treat a Wolof paragraph followed by a French paragraph as one bilingual/mixed-language item when the French restates the Wolof. Treat review reasons, duplicate buckets, repeated text, and row/header overlap as reasons for review, not as automatic merge evidence. Use activity/domain, palier/jéego, week, table/local_code, and objective context only when that context is visible in the candidate descriptions, source_text, statement_type, source references, or review reasons. If the context needed for a safe decision is not visible in the bounded review payload, choose needs_review rather than guessing.

Merge duplicates caused by table row filldown, repeated headers, overlapping extraction windows, or layout continuation only when the candidates clearly represent the same source-visible item within the same visible activity/domain, palier/jéego, table, and objective context. Keep separate candidates when they occur in different activities (for example Expression orale vs Récitation, Lecture vs Production d’écrits), different paliers/jéego, different weeks, different tables, or different objective contexts, unless they are clearly the same curriculum item repeated for layout or overlap reasons. Do not use table numbers, section numbers, week labels, palier/jéego numbers, or objective-order numbers as merge identities.

Repeated-statement policy: For no-code rows, merge exact or near-exact repeated Wolof/French statements only when they share the same visible source role, activity/domain, palier/jéego, table/local_code, and objective context. In detailed oral/lecture tables, repeated Objectif d’apprentissage / Nisaru njàng values may span several weekly rows; treat those repeated broad objectives as one contextual grouping or broad standard only within the same visible activity and palier. For repeated Objectif spécifique / Nisaru jukki bi candidates, merge only when the source text is the same item repeated by overlapping extraction windows, table layout continuation, filldown, or repeated headers. Do not merge distinct specific objectives or weekly practice items merely because their wording is similar or because they appear under the same broad objective.
as.sfi_extraction_instructions:
This is a no-stable-code Senegal CE1 bilingual Wolof/French language-and-communication curriculum. Extract StandardsFrameworkItems from normative curriculum statements, not from pedagogical directions alone. Create Standard Grouping SFIs for the framework, CE1/Étape 2, subdomains/activities such as Communication orale, Lecture, Communication écrite, Production d’écrits, Récitation, paliers/jéego/niveaux, and objective contexts when they organize leaf expectations. Use Outils de langue / Jumtukaayi làkk as an activity/domain grouping when it appears as section or table context; row-level tool-category labels such as Baataan/Vocabulaire, Grammaire, Conjugaison, Orthographe, and Écriture/Copie are local grouping/context labels, not leaf standards by themselves. Create Standard SFIs for Compétence de cycle, Compétence de l’étape, Compétences de sous-domaines, Compétences de base, Objectif d’apprentissage / Nisaru njàng, and Objectifs spécifiques / Nisaru jukki bi when they state what learners are expected to integrate, understand, produce, read, copy, recite, or demonstrate. In detailed oral and lecture tables, the Objectif d’apprentissage column usually contains a broad objective repeated across multiple weekly rows, while Objectifs spécifiques contains the main leaf objectives; emit at most one candidate per distinct repeated Objectif d’apprentissage in a single window and use all visible supporting row indexes, rather than duplicating the same broad objective for every row. In detailed production-writing tables, section headings such as Objectif d’apprentissage 2 / Nisaru njàng 2 may be extracted as broad objective context when the full objective text is visible, but the numeric ordinal alone is not an SFI or statement_code. Treat Contenus / Këmb / Limu ëmb, Durée / Diir, week labels including 1 à 8 or single week numbers, INTÉGRATION, and EVALUATION rows as metadata, descriptors, guidance, or sequencing evidence unless the row itself contains a clear normative objective. Use rows_filldown for interpreting implied palier/week/objective context, but cite raw rows/cells for source fidelity. Do not create a new SFI just because a filldown value repeats across multiple rows. When a cell contains Wolof followed by French conveying the same item, keep them together as one mixed-language candidate with language='mul'. This document has no stable item-level statement codes; do not use table numbers (for example Tableau 1.1.1), section numbers, week numbers, palier/jéego numbers, or objective-order numbers as statement_code. Treat them as provenance or hierarchy context only, and set statement_code to null unless a source row contains a true official item code.

Use only the canonical statement_type values from as.statement_type_policy. For this Senegal Reading curriculum, classify source roles as: Référentiel, Étape, Section, Sous-domaine, Activité, Compétence de cycle, Compétence de l'étape, Compétence de sous-domaine, Compétence de base, Palier, Compétence de palier, Objectif d'apprentissage, or Objectif spécifique. Use Palier only for label-only palier/jéego/sumb groupings or headings; use Compétence de palier for full normative Jéego/Jëego/Sumb/Palier competency statements. Use Sous-domaine for Communication orale or Communication écrite; use Activité for activity organizers such as Expression orale, Récitation, Lecture, Lecture-écriture, Production d’écrits, Copie, or Outils de langue. Do not use English, ambiguous, or compound output labels such as Framework, Stage/Grade, Activity, Activity Domain, Domain, Sub-domain, Activity/Domain, Tool category, Palier/Jéego, or Objectif spécifique / Nisaru jukki bi.
as.sfi_has_child_instructions:
Resolve hasChild relationships for this Senegal CE1 bilingual Wolof/French curriculum using the source-visible curriculum hierarchy, not table numbers, week numbers, section numbers, or inferred codes.

Use the StandardsFramework root only for top-level finalized SFIs or unresolved children. For this document, source-supported direct parentage generally follows this pattern when the relevant finalized parent is present in the bounded candidate set:

- Référentiel / framework-level organizers are top-level under the StandardsFramework root.
- Étape 2 / CE1-level organizers sit under the framework-level organizer when present.
- Major sections such as Schéma intégrateur, Tableau de planification des apprentissages, Activités - Oral, Activités - Lecture, Communication écrite, Production d’écrits, Outils de langue, and Copie organize the items visibly inside those sections.
- Sous-domaine nodes such as Communication orale and Communication écrite organize their corresponding activities and sub-domain competencies.
- Activité nodes such as Expression orale, Récitation, Lecture, Lecture-écriture, Production d’écrits, Outils de langue, and Copie organize their visible paliers, compétences de base, and detailed objective tables.
- Palier/Jéego/Sumb grouping nodes or full Compétence de palier statements organize the objectives within the same visible activity/domain and palier.
- Objectif d’apprentissage / Nisaru njàng is usually a broad objective parent for matching Objectif spécifique / Nisaru jukki bi children in the same table, activity/domain, palier, and local source context.
- Objectif spécifique / Nisaru jukki bi is usually a leaf expectation.
- Do not choose Contenus/Këmb/Limu ëmb, Durées/Diir, week labels, INTÉGRATION, EVALUATION, table captions, or table/section numbers as parents unless they were explicitly finalized as source-visible grouping SFIs and are the most direct source-supported parent.
- Compétence de cycle, Compétence de l’étape, Compétence de sous-domaine, Compétence de base, Compétence de palier, Objectif d’apprentissage, and Objectif spécifique are standards/expectations; choose their parent from the nearest source-visible organizing SFI, not from a reused text label in another activity, palier, table, or section.
- This is a no-stable-code curriculum. Do not choose parents by statement_code, table number, week number, palier number, or objective ordinal. Use source context, table row/header provenance, section labels, activity/domain, palier/jéego/sumb, and visible objective context.
- Repeated labels are common. A repeated Objectif d’apprentissage or activity label should only be used as a parent when it belongs to the same visible activity/domain, palier, table/local context, and source provenance as the child.
- If the bounded candidate set does not contain a source-supported direct parent, mark the child unresolved rather than guessing.
